svg.title: Blank StickerPix design canvas — 96 × 170 mm
svg.desc: Transparent design canvas. One viewBox unit equals one millimeter. Add artwork in the artwork group and keep the surrounding page transparent. stickerpix export --border 0 traces the artwork's outer silhouettes automatically. Positive border values add an outward margin in millimeters, white by default. Use --border-color to change its printed color. Leave enough space between shapes and around the page for that margin. Matching raster template: 1152 × 2040 pixels, at 12 pixels per millimeter.
